input.quote: Notwithstanding the foregoing, Client is not obligated to utilize the License and is free to acquire, develop, license or otherwise utilize any other hardware, software system, design, formula, procedure or trade secret to provide software and services similar to the ones provided by TrueLink hereunder
input.rationale: The Agreement imposes no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation on Client, so it sits at the preferred position. Section 2(a) grants only a non-exclusive licence and expressly confirms Client is not obligated to use the Interface and is free to acquire, develop or license competing software and services. The only sourcing-style covenant, Section 3(i) ("Client shall order TrueLink a credit report on each borrower for which an underwriting approval is requested through a System using the Interface"), is conditioned on Client's voluntary use of the Interface and does not restrict Client from using alternatives, so it is not exclusivity. Section 8(d) grants TrueLink only a nonexclusive licence in Credit Data (its cross-reference to a separate Non-Competition Agreement is outside this document and noted for diligence, not flagged here), and no other clause restricts Client's freedom to buy elsewhere.
